title: slab-admission-and-epoched-prefill-windows-to-reduce-decode-thrashing
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: Interactive workloads with bursty short requests were experiencing tail latency spikes caused by repeated KV cache/decoder thrashing when many small prefill windows overlapped with decode work. This PR introduces a slab-based admission controller and epoched prefill windows to reduce mid-pipeline contention and stabilize kernel scheduling. Design summary: 1) Slab admission: classify incoming prefill candidates into size-classes (tiny, small, medium, large) and admit them into per-slab token reservoirs. Admission enforces configurable concurrency caps per slab so tiny bursts cannot evict medium/large prefills on the same GPU worker. 2) Epoched prefill windows: prefill requests are grouped into short epochs (configurable, default 8ms). Within an epoch we coalesce KV priming and schedule a single warm-pass kernel for compatible size-classes to improve KV cache locality. 3) Kernel coordinator: a thin adaptive coordinator chooses between doing a coalesced warm kernel across an epoch or allowing immediate decode handoff based on real-time metrics (KV hit rate, outstanding decode backlog, per-slab occupancy). 4) Soft backpressure and gentle requeue: when slabs are saturated we apply a lightweight backpressure token to upstream batching; requests are either requeued into the next epoch or opportunistically forwarded to a lower-cost model variant. Implementation notes: - Scheduler changes in runtime/scheduler/slab_admission.cc (approx 680 LOC added/modified). - New metrics in observability/metrics/prefill_slabs.{yaml,proto}. - Config knobs exposed via config/runtime.yaml: slab_sizes, epoch_ms, slab_caps, epoch_coalesce_threshold. - Unit/integration tests under tests/scheduler/test_slab_admission.py and tests/e2e/prefill_epoch_coalescing.py. Performance results (internal perf lab, p50/p99 latencies vs main): - p50 generation latency: -3.2% (better by reduced jitter) - p95 generation latency: -7.9% - p99 token latency: -12.4% for bursty short-prefill workloads - KV cache warmup hit rate improved from 62% to 83% for mixed-size traces Rollout plan: feature-gated behind runtime.prefill_slab_admission; staged rollout to canary fleet (10%) -> 50% -> 100% with automatic rollback on p99 regressions >10%. Checklist: [x] design doc linked [x] unit tests [x] integration tests [x] perf numbers attached [x] config toggles + conservative defaults [x] metrics and dashboards updated

review_comments: Ravi Patel: The slab caps look reasonable but we need a safety net for runaway allocations; add a global per-worker token limit.
Maya Chen (author): Added global_worker_capacity and a guard in slab_admission.cc; included tests that assert the guard triggers when occupancy would exceed the worker limit.
Elena Gomez: Please surface the epoch_ms as a dynamic flag for experimentation in canary.
Maya Chen (author): Exposed epoch_ms via runtime flag and added migration note in docs/rfc/prefill-slab-admission.md.
Thom Brooks: Observability looks good; suggest adding a derived metric for 'coalesce_rate' (epochs that chose warm kernel / total epochs).
Maya Chen (author): Added coalesce_rate gauge and dashboard tile.
ci_summary: Initial CI failed on lint (line-length) and a race detected by TSAN in epoch_coalescer; fixed in deadbe2 and CI passed on rerun. All unit tests and the perf lab harness passed. E2E rerun included a 2-hour soak on canary.
release_notes: Runtime: add slab-based prefill admission and epoched prefill coalescing to reduce KV thrash and stabilize decode latency. Feature gated off by default (runtime.prefill_slab_admission=false).
notes_for_ops: Enable behind feature flag. Recommended default slab_caps: tiny=256, small=1024, medium=4096, large=16384. Monitor metrics: slab_occupancy, epoch_coalesce_rate, kv_warm_hit_rate, p99_token_latency. Rollout carefully on canary and watch for increased decode queue lengths.
testing_instructions: 1) Run unit: pytest tests/scheduler/test_slab_admission.py 2) Start local runtime with --prefill_slab_admission and --epoch_ms=8 3) Run e2e mixed-size script: tests/e2e/run_mixed_prefill.sh 4) Validate metrics: curl http://localhost:9090/metrics | grep prefill_slabs
changelog: Implemented slab admission and epoch coalescer; added metrics and config; tests and docs.
